chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Suleyman ibn Ja'far, who said:

I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), 'What do you say regarding the drinking of al-fuqqa'?' He said: 'It is an unknown wine, O Suleyman, so do not drink it. Indeed, O Suleyman, if the ruling were mine and the house were mine, I would whip its drinker and kill its seller.'

key_terms.الْفُقَّاعِ: A specific type of fermented drink, often identified as beer or a barley-based beverage.
key_terms.خَمْرٌ مَجْهُولٌ: Unknown wine; a legal category for drinks where intoxication is uncertain but likely.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on drinking al-fuqqa according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) classifies 'al-fuqqa'' as 'unknown wine' (khamr majhul), advising against its consumption due to uncertainty about its intoxicating properties. He emphasizes that if he had full authority, he would impose severe penalties (whipping the drinker and killing the seller) to deter its use. This ruling highlights the Shia principle of 'istishab' (presumption of continuity) combined with 'ihtiyat' (precaution), where uncertainty in intoxication leads to prohibition, reflecting the broader jurisprudential approach to novel fermented beverages.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya and someone else, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan Reza<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding the fermented drink?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘An unknown wine, O Suleyman, therefore do not drink it. But, O Suleyman, had the rule been mine<sup>asws</sup>, and the house were mine, I<sup>asws</sup> would whip its drinker and kill its seller’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya and others have narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Sulayman ibn Ja‘far who has said the following:

“I once asked abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about al-Fuqa ’. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is an unknown wine, O Sulayman and do not drink it. Had the command been in my hand and the house was my house, I would whip its drinker and execute its seller.’”
